item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. It's simple to say and easy to let slide when the day gets full. Take what you're prescribed, at the time you're prescribed it, the same way every day. Consistency matters more than willpower. If a dose gets missed or something feels off, don't guess or adjust on your own. Ask your prescriber. Your action: tie your next dose to a fixed daily habit, and do it today.
